items.criterion: The health read returns a ready status.
items.judgment: The health endpoint answers 200.

items.criterion: The published site read returns the rooms in their published order.
items.judgment: The site read answers 200 with the rooms in order.

items.criterion: A published room scene streams from the stored object under the room key.
items.judgment: The scene read answers 200 and the object exists in the store under the room key.

items.criterion: The header player lists the published releases in position order.
items.judgment: The releases read answers 200 in position order.

items.criterion: A signed-in visitor signs one standing guest-book note.
items.judgment: The sign answers 201 and one standing note exists for that visitor on that site.

items.criterion: A creator upload writes the room scene to the object store.
items.judgment: The upload answers 200 and the scene object exists in the store.

items.criterion: Publishing copies the working copy into the published snapshot.
items.judgment: After publish the public read returns the published snapshot.

items.criterion: A room edited after publishing stays off the public read until the next publish.
items.judgment: A fresh public read returns the last snapshot until a second publish.

items.criterion: The public site read reconciles with the latest published snapshot rows.
items.judgment: The listed rooms match the latest snapshot rows in the database.

items.criterion: A creator reorders the rooms on the owned site.
items.judgment: The order write answers 200 and the rooms take the requested order.

items.criterion: A creator hides a standing note off the public guest book.
items.judgment: The hide answers 200 and the note leaves the public book.

items.criterion: A creator restores a hidden note to the public guest book.
items.judgment: The restore answers 200 and the note returns to the public book.

items.criterion: A signed-out studio request is refused.
items.judgment: The anonymous studio request answers 401 with not-signed-in.

items.criterion: A visitor studio request is refused.
items.judgment: The visitor studio request answers 403 with not-allowed-for-you.

items.criterion: A creator writing against a site the caller does not own is refused.
items.judgment: The cross-owner write answers 403 with not-allowed-for-you and the site is unchanged.

items.criterion: A public read of a draft site is refused.
items.judgment: The draft site read answers 404 with no-such-thing.

items.criterion: A public read of a draft room scene is refused.
items.judgment: The draft scene read answers 404 with no-such-thing.

items.criterion: A signed-out guest-book sign is refused.
items.judgment: The anonymous sign answers 401 with not-signed-in and writes nothing.

items.criterion: A second standing note by one visitor on one site is refused.
items.judgment: The repeat sign answers 409 with that-clashes and writes no second note.

items.criterion: A guest-book sign missing the note text is refused.
items.judgment: The invalid sign answers 400 or 422 with something-missing-or-wrong.

items.criterion: A privacy page reads from the footer.
items.judgment: The privacy page answers 200 and a footer links to it.

items.criterion: Each public route answers a distinct document title.
items.judgment: No two public routes answer the same title.

items.criterion: The sitemap lists every public route.
items.judgment: The sitemap read answers 200 and names every public route.
